_about: Settings shared by the change detector (src/detect.py), the checker (src/check_sources.py) and the scraper (src/monitor.py). user_agent: how they introduce themselves to websites. timeout_s: how long to wait for a page. delay_s: the pause between two pages on the same site, so no site gets more than one request at a time. sources_file: the rules for checking records (src/sources.csv). drop_selectors: parts of a page to ignore: navigation, headers, footers, cookie banners. main_selectors: where to look for the main content, in order; the body if none match. site_drop_selectors: extra parts to ignore on particular sites, such as panels repeated on every page. watch_fields: the record fields src/check_sources.py writes scraper recipes for and src/monitor.py checks (who and access are checked once, when a record is verified; postcode isn't watched, as it only changes with the address).
